profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors, with the tagline "Own the study hour." The site's footer states that Course Hero is a Learneo, Inc. business and that it is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City.

Among the products tracked for the company is QuillBot, listed under writing and editing with a note of paraphrasing. No litigation, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for Course Hero.
